query: SELECT pc.mes, pc.ano, SUM(ls.valor) as total FROM lancamento_salario ls JOIN periodo_custo pc ON ls.periodoCustoId = pc.id WHERE pc.mes IN (4,5) AND pc.ano = 2026 GROUP BY pc.mes, pc.ano;
